name: vnsgu-result-website

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('frontend/dist/index.html','backend/public/index.html');console.log('Frontend synced to backend/public/index.html');"
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/public/index.html')){require('child_process').execSync('npm run build:frontend');}console.log('Build ready: backend/public/index.html verified');"
